primarySourceResearch.name: CompStore
primarySourceResearch.note: The product sitemap contains AZ/RU URLs and may contain non-products. Its URL count is not a verified unique inventory count.
primarySourceResearch.parserHint: Existing Product JSON-LD reader can extract sample cash price, stock and image. Accept same-host product .html URLs, exclude /ru/ and category/info routes, and require a Product with positive AZN Offer.

primarySourceResearch.name: UltraStore
primarySourceResearch.note: The sitemap duplicates language versions. Respect robots restrictions on specials/search/cart and query sort/order. This is a read-only integration candidate, not imported inventory.
primarySourceResearch.parserHint: Product JSON-LD has positive AZN price, stock, image, brand and MPN; decode HTML entities in name/MPN. Product image entries with -az paths identify AZ candidates.

primarySourceResearch.name: Smarton
primarySourceResearch.note: Crawl-delay:30 was respected. The index advertises five child maps; only child0 was read in this bounded audit. AZ and RU entries are mixed. Sample prose contains an old price; do not derive price from description.
primarySourceResearch.parserHint: Restrict to /mehsullar/ AZ product URLs; generic Product JSON-LD gives current offer price, stock, brand and image. Keep 30-second per-host cadence.

primarySourceResearch.name: Aztech
primarySourceResearch.note: Advertised WordPress REST root is accessible but exposes no WooCommerce Store API namespace or product routes. Its advertised sitemap contains posts/pages/news, not a verified price catalog. No price-feed integration is claimed.
primarySourceResearch.parserHint: Needs a product/feed source or product-specific adapter before any price integration can be marked connected.

limits: A directory/profile count is not a connected live-price store count.
A sitemap URL count includes language aliases, stale URLs and possibly category/blog pages; it is not an imported product count.
Prices with unknown stock are not counted as currently in stock.
Configured updater schedules do not prove an unattended execution occurred.
Newly researched sources remain disconnected until an adapter/import is verified and the resulting records are read back.
